title: Assurance bundles triggered by usage thresholds
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise buyers frequently stall procurement while waiting for curated security evidence (SIG/CAIQ responses, SOC summaries, encryption attestations). Current process is manual, slow, and inconsistent across sales reps, increasing sales cycles and load on the security team.

Proposal: Create pre-packaged "assurance bundles" that are automatically offered and gated by customer usage thresholds and contract stage. Bundles include a curated SIG/CAIQ answer pack, a short attestation PDF, and a checklist of follow-up artifacts (e.g., SOC access instructions, encryption keyflow). Bundles will be surfaced by console and sales UI and optionally attached to contracts. We will run a pricing/crediting experiment to offer these bundles as a free inclusion up to a threshold (e.g., monthly committed spend) and evaluate converting to a credit or paid add-on above thresholds.

Scope: Design bundle templates for standard enterprise personas, implement UI affordances in the console (product and billing surfaces), integrate with the security evidence store, create an automated trigger system (usage thresholds + sales stage), and define pricing/credit experiment parameters. Excludes on-prem specific attestations (follow-up ticket).

Success metrics: 
- Reduction in average time-to-sign (contract execution) for deals requesting attestations by 20% within 3 months of rollout.
- Number of bundles auto-issued vs manual evidence requests. Target 60% automation rate for eligible deals.
- Customer satisfaction (CSAT) on the attestation onboarding flow >= 8/10 in post-onboarding survey.
- Security team workload on ad-hoc SIG requests reduced by 30%.

Acceptance criteria: 
- 3 bundle templates (Startup, Mid-market, Enterprise) authored and reviewed by Security/Legal.
- Console UI surfaces bundle eligibility on customer billing page and sales CRM card.
- Automatic email + download link delivered to eligible customers and logged in audit trail.
- Pricing experiment configuration defined (thresholds, credit amounts, duration) and tracked in analytics.
- Security review completed and attestation artifacts signed-off.

Rollout plan: 
1) Week 0-2: Finalize templates and pricing experiment parameters with Security and Revenue Ops.
2) Week 3-4: Implement backend triggers and bundle delivery pipeline; QA with internal customers.
3) Week 5: Launch pilot to 10 sales accounts (MID/ENT) and monitor.
4) Week 6-12: Collect metrics, iterate on copy/attachments; decide scale and pricing.

Risks & trade-offs: 
- Over-bundling sensitive evidence could expose data; mitigate by limiting artifacts to non-sensitive summaries and preserving SOC access gating.
- If thresholds are set too low we may create operational load/costs; conservative initial thresholds recommended.
- Need to avoid doubling-up with existing attestation projects (see dependencies).
